summary: Several kubectl tools concatenated tool arguments (resource type, name, namespace) into a command string run by execSync(), so a crafted argument ran shell commands with the server's cluster credentials.

vulnerable.description: kubectl_describe builds a shell string from tool arguments

safe.description: execFileSync("kubectl", args) with one array element per value

notes: Verified by diffing the published 2.4.9 and 2.5.0 tarballs (dist/tools/kubectl-describe.js and siblings). The advisory lists CWE-77.
